text.tspan: refreshConversations() → GET /api/conversations → list_conversations() → SELECT ... ORDER BY updated_at DESC
OpenAI provider: ChatOpenAI → POST api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions, Authorization Bearer
no tool call, the answer streams from the first completion request
[model decides the question needs the uploaded documents]

g.text: [model answers directly, or RAG disabled (no embedding deployment, no tools bound)]

text.tspan: On any exception: logger.exception() and data: {"type":"error","message":...} instead of done, then on.error() shows it under the assistant message

svg.text: setMessages(+ user msg, + empty assistant msg)
conv_id = conversation_id or uuid4(), title = first 60 chars
INSERT INTO conversations (id, title) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
agent node: SYSTEM_PROMPT + history + new user msg
tools node (ToolNode) → retrieve_documents(query) in worker thread
ORDER BY cosine distance to query vector LIMIT 4
ToolMessage "[source: file, page n] chunk text ..."
agent node again: history + tool call + ToolMessage
reader.read() → TextDecoder → split on blank line → JSON.parse
aput() final state (user msg + AI answer)
finally: UPDATE conversations SET updated_at = now()
